name: dev
description: Development lifecycle in one bundle. GitHub workflow: commit-and-push, decompose-issue, resolve-issue, release, cr-fix (unified CodeRabbit + ChatGPT-Codex review loop with autonomous apply/defer/skip judgment and rate-limit fallback), post-merge (branch cleanup + config/wiki integration with a mandatory wiki-lore ingest), state-tracker (spec/issue/PR aggregate over .claude/state/spec.json), orchestrate (subagent orchestration: job cards, model x effort worker presets, disjoint file ownership, bounded re-query, orchestrator-owned verification), diagnose (bug-diagnosis discipline: capture a failing command before hypothesizing, then falsify ranked hypotheses instead of guessing), flow (short router over this flow: decompose-issue -> resolve-issue -> cr-fix -> post-merge, branch points, no side effects of its own). Project setup: new (first-day bootstrap: interview, .claude/ scaffold, CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md with Codex reviewer guidelines, gh repo create) and wiring (14-axis harness diagnostic for an existing repo, read-only until approved). Playwright E2E harness: e2e-setup, e2e-author, e2e-debug wrap Playwright's planner/generator/healer agents (planner/generator explore via playwright-cli, healer via the playwright-test MCP server); never overwrite an existing playwright.config and degrade gracefully without Playwright.
